ai_review.summary: Terrific soundboard master captures a confident, youthful summer‑'72 performance.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise this recording as an excellent listen, noting the pristine soundboard source and the band’s rested, confident vibe early in their five‑month run. The performance feels young and energetic, making it a fresh snapshot of the Dead at their peak in mid‑1972.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 4‑star ratings and highlighted strong show energy plus a high‑quality soundboard source; limited to two reviews, so confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a terrific master of the soundboard with clear, strong audio and no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑summer set shows a rested, confident band delivering consistently solid playing throughout.
